newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila stocks end down as PLDT runs out of steam.
newsitem.headline: Manila stocks end down as PLDT runs out of steam.

text.p: * Oil and mining issues defy downtrend
Philippine shares ended weaker after a firm start on Thursday as market leader PLDT failed to sustain its rise due to profit taking, brokers said.
The main index fell by 11.56 points to 3,237.03 at close, down from the day's high of 3,256.10.
"The market was up in early trade as investors took a cue from the steep $1.25 rise of PLDT's ADRs in Wall Street overnight," said Monique Lecaros at Armstrong Securities.
Except for PLDT and a few mining and oil issues, the rest of the market was generally weak due to the absence of most foreign investors, said Elphege Wong at Bernard Securities.
PLDT rose to a year's high of 1,720 pesos before falling back to end at 1,700, up 25 pesos from Wednesday's close.
"Worries over a U.S. rate hike continue to hover in the market," Wong said.
Lecaros said the local market would continue to follow the Dow Jones in the absence of fresh local incentives.
About 2.7 billion pesos worth of shares were traded.
